【原视频简介】
Voyager 2 just found something impossible in interstellar space — and scientists are stunned. This video breaks down NASA's Voyager 2 spacecraft, its historic 2018 heliopause crossing, and the bizarre discovery that the edge of our solar system isn't a solid wall but a leaky, ever-shifting boundary between the sun and interstellar space. We cover the Voyager 1 vs Voyager 2 naming mystery, the legendary Grand Tour of Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune, the 2019 Nature Astronomy findings that stunned physicists, and NASA's high-risk 2026 "Big Bang" power procedure that could keep this 49-year-old spacecraft alive for years longer — or end the mission for good. If you love deep space exploration, NASA history, and real interstellar science explained simply, this one's for you.
